title: Does Eating 5 Apples a Day Really Boost Immunity?

scenes.text: Can 5 apples a day actually protect you from colds?

scenes.label: More apples = stronger immun
scenes.text: People think the old “an apple a day keeps the doctor away” means you need many apples for immune power.

scenes.label: Apples help, but not magic
scenes.query: vitamin C content apple compare orange
scenes.text: Apples contain vitamin C and antioxidants, but the amount is modest; a balanced diet with varied fruits provides better immune support.
